topic: Why GTA 6 took 13 years after GTA V (launch day)
title: Why GTA 6 took 13 years to come out #shorts
lines: GTA 6 comes out today. So why did it take thirteen years?
GTA 5 launched in September 2013, and it never stopped selling.
More than two hundred thirty million copies.
Rockstar didn't need a sequel. The old game was still printing money.
Then in December 2023, the first GTA 6 trailer dropped.
Ninety million views in twenty-four hours. A world record.
The game was set for fall 2025. Then May 2026. Then delayed again, to November nineteenth.
But here's the twist. Every delay only made the hype bigger.
And the bigger the hype, the more people ask...
why did it take thirteen years?
description: GTA 6 is finally out, 13 years after GTA 5. Here's why it took so long. 🎮 #gta6 #gtavi #gaming #rockstargames #shorts
